scope: Immutable source-to-catalog mapping for every included named entry. It records the finite source boundary, locator, normalized identity and known normalization; it does not copy source descriptions or claim to enumerate every software pattern ever published.

source.title: Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software

families.limitations: Publisher page identifies the book; the immutable entry list records the audited book catalog because the publisher page does not expose every pattern heading.

families.source_locator: A pattern language for microservices, linked entries grouped by index section

families.source_locator: POSA Volume 2 Table of Contents, chapters 2-5 and explicit 17 patterns/idioms statement

families.source_locator: Workflow Patterns index, control-flow, data and resource collections
families.limitations: The source is legacy HTTP; finite control-flow, data and resource indexes are included, while configurable exception-handling combinations are excluded.
